messages:
Ivy: spotted a small billing delta: console shows ~200 reqs as project:unknown for org-lumen between 11:03-11:10. anyone?
Omar: any sample req id/edge?
Ivy: req id a12b3c, us-east-1. upstream header had x-project:analytics but auth service shows null.
Quinn: likely introspect failing and router falling back to org-only. we've seen this pattern.
Nate: can we avoid silently changing rateband? even if introspect fails we should mark as soft-attributed and keep project buckets until reconciliation.
Sasha: product will want explicit UX for soft attribution. propose console shows "soft:analytics" with a yellow badge and a tooltip: "header seen but not verified". also add CTA "request pin (billing confirmation)".
Ivy: telemetry action: add attr_origin=header|introspect, attr_confidence=high|soft|none, and attribution_reason=introspect_error|missing_claim|ok. That will let dashboards filter.
Omar: infra: router change behind flag: preserve header attribution as soft when introspect times out, and publish audit events for any later reconciliation.
Quinn: reconciliation job idea: listen to auth-change stream for up to 48h, if a soft event gets verified publish billing-reassign {req,old_attr,new_attr,reconciled_at}. accounting can then retro-charge.
Nate: alerts: add rule for introspect 5xx > 0.5%/5m and soft-attribution ratio > 0.5%/10m per org. Also add runbook link.
Sasha: UX owner: I'll mock the yellow badge + pin flow. need copy for tooltip and pin confirmation. Legal wants admin consent flow.
Ivy: owners: telemetry (Omar), router (Quinn), reconciliation (Nate), UX (Sasha). timeline: telemetry + alerts today (2h), router flag this week (1w), janitor job 2w. I'll file RFC and link tickets.
DevBot: created ticket ENG-3117 (telemetry) and ENG-3118 (alerts).
Omar: fine with names. will push schema PR shortly.
Quinn: will prototype router flag and coordinate with Nate for reconciliation hooks.
Sasha: will post mock later today.
Ivy: thanks all, keeping this thread open until janitor runs and console pin is gated by legal. :thumbsup:
